description: a11ign/agent-org's Renovate config (a11ign/a11ign#5153, item 1; replaces the bespoke project-ref-bump.yml of #5151). It advances ONE pin: PROJECT_REF in .github/workflows/ci.yml, the a11ign/a11ign commit this repository's suite runs against. A bump is a digest update of a11ign/a11ign `main`, opened on `bot/project-ref-bump` (the branch src/ci-failure-class.ts reads to class a pull request red only on pin drift as waiting on the bump), and the preset's automerge hands it to GitHub's auto-merge, so this repository's own `gate` and the merge queue decide it. Revert: set `enabled` to false.

customManagers.description: PROJECT_REF: the a11ign/a11ign commit sha ci.yml runs the tool's suite against (a full 40-hex sha, which src/ci-pins-the-project.test.ts holds it to)

packageRules.description: One fixed branch for the one pin, so there is at most one bump pull request and it is the one src/ci-failure-class.ts looks for. A digest update has no version: the title names the two shas.
